NAME: GPIO verification plan
details: Block 19: garuda_gpio_top, the vendored PULP apb_gpio behind the APB shim, two pins. Source: GARUDA-GPIO-SPEC-001. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md. Vendored code is covered as far as the two-pin configuration reaches; the rest is waived with the reason.

NAME: A Registers
details: APB window 7, 0x4000_7000. Spec section 6. Only bits 1:0 of each pin register are meaningful.

NAME: F01 PADDIR selects output or input per pin
details: Offset 0x00, read-write, reset 0. Bit n 1 drives pin n. Bits 31:2 read 0.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_gpio [R-3], [R-4]. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: ral_access PADDIR
details: Reset value, read-back of bits 1:0, bits 31:2 read 0.
implementation_note: gpio_reg_test in tb/gpio/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/gpio.rdl). Passing.

NAME: F02 GPIOEN enables a pins input path and interrupt
details: Offset 0x04, read-write, reset 0. A pin that is read or used as an interrupt source needs its bit set. Spec [N-6.1]. In the RTL the input flops of both pins run when either bit is set, and with both clear PADIN holds its last value (BUGS.md GPIO-2).
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: tb_gpio sets it; nothing checks the pin with it clear. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: sb_padin
details: The reference model gates the input path with GPIOEN; PADIN and the interrupt are compared.
implementation_note: gpio_scoreboard in tb/gpio/uvm/gpio_env_pkg.sv, against gpio_ref_model. 0 mismatches in 22 runs. Also checked from the pads alone - gpio_scoreboard, from the pads, the registers and the pins alone (no synchroniser model) - 10008 settled PADIN levels, 7452 pad edges and 530 interrupt rises in 22 runs, 0 mismatches.

NAME: cg_gpio_en.x_gpioen_use
details: Each pin read and used as an interrupt source with GPIOEN 0 and 1.
implementation_note: gpio_coverage in tb/gpio/uvm/gpio_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F03 PADIN reads the level on the pin
details: Offset 0x08, read-only. It shows the pin, not PADOUT, so a driven pin can be read back. Spec [N-7.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: tb_gpio [R-2]. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: sb_padin
details: Every PADIN read compared with the pin level five pclk earlier.
implementation_note: gpio_scoreboard in tb/gpio/uvm/gpio_env_pkg.sv, against gpio_ref_model. 0 mismatches in 22 runs. Also checked from the pads alone - gpio_scoreboard, from the pads, the registers and the pins alone (no synchroniser model) - 10008 settled PADIN levels, 7452 pad edges and 530 interrupt rises in 22 runs, 0 mismatches.

NAME: F04 PADOUT holds the value driven
details: Offset 0x0C, read-write, reset 0.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_gpio [R-1]. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: ral_access PADOUT
details: Reset value and read-back.
implementation_note: gpio_reg_test in tb/gpio/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/gpio.rdl). Passing.

NAME: F05 PADOUTSET and PADOUTCLR change one pin without touching the other
details: Offsets 0x10 and 0x14, write-only. A 1 sets or clears that bit of PADOUT; a 0 leaves it. Spec [N-6.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: no check. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: sb_padout
details: The model applies set and clear; PADOUT and the pins are compared.
implementation_note: gpio_scoreboard in tb/gpio/uvm/gpio_env_pkg.sv, against gpio_ref_model. 0 mismatches in 22 runs.

NAME: cg_gpio_out.x_setclr_pin
details: Set and clear on each pin with the other pin 0 and 1; both bits in one write; set and clear of the same bit in consecutive writes.
implementation_note: gpio_coverage in tb/gpio/uvm/gpio_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F06 INTEN and INTTYPE select the interrupt condition per pin
details: Offsets 0x18 and 0x1C, read-write, reset 0. INTTYPE has two bits per pin - 00 falling, 01 rising, 10 either edge, 11 level. In the RTL type 11 raises no interrupt at all (BUGS.md GPIO-2). INTTYPE uses bits 3:0.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_gpio [R-6] falling, rising, either. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: ral_access INTEN INTTYPE
details: Reset value and read-back; bits for pins that do not exist read 0.
implementation_note: gpio_reg_test in tb/gpio/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/gpio.rdl). Passing.

NAME: F07 INTSTATUS names the pin and clears when read
details: Offset 0x24. Bit n is set when pin n caused an interrupt; the bits accumulate; a read returns them and clears them. Spec [N-7.3]. A read in the same cycle as a new event does not clear; the old bits stay and nothing is lost (BUGS.md GPIO-2).
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: tb_gpio [R-6] cause and self-clear. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: sb_intstatus
details: Model compare on every read; the next read returns 0 unless a new event arrived.
implementation_note: gpio_scoreboard in tb/gpio/uvm/gpio_env_pkg.sv, against gpio_ref_model. 0 mismatches in 22 runs.

NAME: cg_gpio_irq.cp_intstatus
details: Read with pin 0 only, pin 1 only, both; an event in the cycle of the read.
implementation_note: gpio_coverage in tb/gpio/uvm/gpio_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F08 PADCFG0 is writable and has no effect
details: Offset 0x28. There are no pad cells in RTL. Spec [N-13.1].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: no check. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: ral_access PADCFG0
details: Read-back; no output of the block changes.
implementation_note: gpio_reg_test in tb/gpio/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/gpio.rdl). Passing.

NAME: F09 IRQSTAT IRQEN DMACTL and ID in the shim
details: Offsets 0xFE0 to 0xFEC. IRQSTAT bit 0 is write-1-to-clear; IRQEN bit 0 masks; DMACTL has no effect because GPIO has no DMA channel; ID reads 0x6A5D, block 19 and the revision.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_gpio reads ID, uses IRQSTAT and IRQEN. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: ral_access shim
details: Access policy of the four shim registers.
implementation_note: gpio_reg_test in tb/gpio/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/gpio.rdl). Passing.

NAME: a_no_dma_req
details: GPIO never raises a DMA request.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/gpio/gpio_sva.sv, bound to garuda_gpio_top. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, the directed bench and the chip tests; seen to trigger.

NAME: F10 Unmapped offsets raise PSLVERR and change nothing
details: 0x80 to 0xFDC, 0xFF0 and above, and unaligned offsets in the shim range, on reads and writes. 0x20 and 0x2C to 0x7C are inside the vendored register file - they read 0 and raise no error, although the specification does not list them (BUGS.md GPIO-2).
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: tb_gpio - one offset. Now: all 2 items passing.

details: Each unmapped range read and written.
implementation_note: gpio_coverage in tb/gpio/uvm/gpio_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F11 Bits 31 -2 read 0 in every register
details: The vendored register file is 32 pins wide; the wrapper exposes two. Bits above the two pins read 0 - bits 31:2, except INTTYPE (two bits per pin, 31:4) and PADCFG0 (four bits per pin, 31:8). Spec [N-6.2] says 31:2 for every register and needs that correction.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_gpio [R-4]. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: ral_access width
details: All ones written to each register reads back with bits 31:2 at 0.
implementation_note: gpio_reg_test in tb/gpio/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/gpio.rdl). Passing.

implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_gpio [R-5]. Now: all 2 items passing.

implementation_note: SVA a_shim_pready in rtl/common/garuda_apb_shim_sva.sv, bound to the shim of every peripheral. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, six block benches and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.
